say: Starting clean. Building a hex-tiled cube seen through a lit plasma field.
1/9 — a domain warp first. Everything downstream gets evaluated in bent space.
2/9 — the z-sliced superquadric: the HAL cube, drawn as stacked cross-sections.
3/9 — wiring swirl into its DOMAIN, not its colour. Green wire, because vec2.
4/9 — a plasma field: the medium the cube will sit inside.
5/9 — compositing. Screen not add: both are already bright and add would clip. Watch a blend node get inserted automatically.
6/9 — superlinear highlight. Crests bloom, mids sink — darker AND brighter at once.
7/9 — tanh. Nothing above it is bounded, so this is the shoulder that stops it blowing out. It must come AFTER the highlight.
8/9 — a cubic vignette to frame it.
…and into OUTPUT. Nothing renders until something reaches the sink.

name: watch-hexcube-fog
say: Done — snapshotting exactly what you are looking at.
